name: RAYTHEIA
definition: RAYTHEIA is a high-performance reverse ray-tracing algorithm designed to efficiently solve three-dimensional direction-dependent equations in astronomical simulations, specifically for photodissociation regions (PDRs).
summary: RAYTHEIA is a high-performance reverse ray-tracing algorithm for astronomical simulations that efficiently computes direction-dependent radiative transfer in absorption-dominated regimes using a leaf-only linear-octree and DDA traversal.
